_doc: Recorded query rewrites for the deep-search benchmark (--deep-search). One entry per query in test-queries-vocab-mismatch.json, keyed by the EXACT query string. Each holds the 3 variants a query-rewriter (deep-search.mjs buildRewritePrompt) is meant to emit: [0] keyword/tech-term form, [1] concept expansion, [2] HyDE hypothetical sentence. METHODOLOGY: variants were authored from the QUERY TEXT + the query's stated intent (desc) using general domain knowledge only (e.g. 'container orchestration' -> 'Kubernetes' is textbook) — NOT by inspecting relevant_ids or the corpus, so the benchmark measures the production fusion path on representative rewrites rather than cherry-picked headwords. This freezes the deterministic CEILING of the fusion machinery (all rewrites usable). Live Haiku reliability is lower (#8731: 5/12 rewrites came back empty); deep-search.mjs always keeps the original query as variant[0], so the live result lands between the single-query baseline (floor, R@10 ~0.33) and this ceiling, never below baseline. Re-record from live Haiku by capturing rewriteQuery() output per query. Authored 2026-06-21.
